committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 26 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Last 7 days ad spend fell to $122.11 from $153.27 while clicks dropped to 18 from 25, and conversions stayed at zero, the same as the week before.
30-day impression share sits at 10%, with 74.7% lost to rank against only 18.9% lost to budget, so ad rank is the limiter, not budget; CTR also slipped to 2.7% from 3.1%.
Total paid clicks on the test page have reached 61 since 6 Oct against 10 ask_cta_click events, and the page has been frozen since click 25 with no changes allowed unless something breaks.
AI Assistant sessions ticked up to 2 from 1, both from chatgpt.com, while Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, fell to 5 sessions from 16.

actions.text: Treat the page as frozen: total paid clicks are now 61, well past the click-25 freeze point, so hold the headline, offer and CTAs unless something is broken.
Source the outstanding logo and image assets for the Agency and Job Intake ad groups.
Update the RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads that still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success, align them with current site stats.
